author: opus-5.5
body: [opus 5.5] Closed: delivered in 'vibe-talk: let the right column scroll past its foot at a desk so its last card can sit mid-screen'. At a desk the right column (its cards, a thread in it, and the thread list on its own, Ctrl+3) scrolls on past its foot into blank room until its last card's top is at half the column's height. The foot is still where every list opens, lands and is followed from. The room opens only as the reader goes on down from the foot: a turn of the wheel once the wheel and the list have rested there for 150 ms, PgDn or Space pressed afresh, or the down arrow pressed afresh on the last card; a fling of the wheel or a held key stops on the foot (the work-in-progress detent design, kept as decided). In the room the reader counts as at the newest, the jump stays down, a reply arriving opens under the card being read, and the room is refitted to the last card; the last card changing size under the reader (pressed and shown whole, put out) is fitted to before the frame is drawn and left where they had it. The room closes going back up past the foot, after 700 ms resting at the foot, on End and the Newest chip, and when the column shows anything else, including another search or filter. Measured: tests/column_overscroll_browser.py (new DAG step column-overscroll-browser) passes at 1280x800 and 1920x1080, and each of its six negative controls fails at its own check (no room drawn: WHEEL; the room not the foot: JUMP; a follower taken to the foot: STILL; no rest asked of the wheel: DETENT; the last card's change of size not held: HIGHLIGHT; the search not part of what the room was opened over: SEARCH). The wheel check is now deterministic in what it judges: the walk records when the page heard each turn and judges a fling only when every gap is shorter than the rest the checked-out page states, throws again otherwise, and fails as DETENT INCONCLUSIVE after three loose flings rather than passing. Three new page-suite tests with negative controls; the page suite passed. Not covered, for the owner to decide: a thread opened across the window from the thread list is in the left column's list and gets no room, nor does Main in one column. Unverified: only headless Chromium 149; a real notched wheel and a trackpad's momentum were not tried. A main thread stalled for 150 ms in the middle of a fling makes the next turn look like a rest, and it goes into the room.
